description: SHA-256 values and sizes of the files of the LAB-2 whole-lab pack that this repository does not hold: complete proofs are reference solutions, which stay in a private place (spine section 11.1). The three fixtures are the files the recorded run mounted; each variant is made from Solution.lean by `mutate.mjs <name>` and is byte for byte the file that ran. scripts/spikes/W0-S06/mutate.mjs --solutions DIR --verify checks a directory against this list. assemble-run.mjs copies it into the record's inputs[].

variants.name: variants/Solution.weak.lean
variants.what: transfer_nonneg gets an extra hypothesis (n = 0): a weaker statement than the challenge, so comparator finds a statement mismatch

variants.name: variants/Solution.redef.lean
variants.what: transfer is redefined as the identity, and the three theorems about it are re-proved for that definition: comparator finds a constant that does not match

variants.name: variants/Solution.axiom.lean
variants.what: transfer_conserves is proved from a custom axiom, `cheat`

variants.name: variants/Solution.native.lean
variants.what: transfer_rejected uses a helper proved with native_decide, which adds an axiom of its own

variants.name: variants/Solution.kernelskip.lean
variants.what: transfer_conserves is added to the environment with the kernel check skipped, with a proof (`trivial`) that the kernel would reject

variants.name: variants/Solution.missing.lean
variants.what: the last theorem, xfer_self, is left out

variants.name: variants/Solution.builderror.lean
variants.what: the proof of transfer_conserves names a lemma that does not exist, so the project does not build
